subject: POC Traffic acceptance rubric & kickoff handover
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex@halcyonai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@halcyonai.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC Traffic acceptance rubric & kickoff handover

Thanks again for the call earlier, Alex — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the kickoff.

High-level objective:
- Run a 2-week POC that validates latency and cost targets for your customer-facing summarization feature while exercising your peak burst windows.

Success criteria (proposal) — please confirm:
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 350ms at sustained 400 RPS baseline (single region).
- Burst: system handles 10x baseline (4k RPS) for 30s windows without error rate > 2%.
- Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens during steady state < $0.85 (Redwood-side optimizations allowed).
- Quality parity: automated rouge-like checks on a blind prompt set to show no >5% degradation vs. baseline model.

Traffic profile we discussed:
- Typical steady-state: ~400 RPS, average input length ~120 tokens, average output ~220 tokens.
- Concurrency: expected 80 concurrent sessions (average).
- Burst windows: 30–45s bursts during campaign sends, up to ~4k RPS.

Ask from your side for kickoff:
- Confirm the sample traffic CSV and a 30-min sample trace (headers/timing).
- Confirm procurement contact (I added Priya here) — any required contract or security slack?
- Approve the proposed success criteria or flag any numbers to adjust.

How Redwood will support:
- We’ll provide a prebuilt load harness and a traffic replay plan (you can opt to run it or give us ephemeral credentials).
- Draft success rubric (attached stub) we’ll finalize with Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (SE).

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm numbers by EOD 2027-08-24
- Internal handover / dry run 2027-08-27
- POC kickoff window 2027-08-30 – 2027-09-13

Attachments: poc-success-rubric-v1.xlsx (draft), traffic-sample-202708.csv (empty stub)

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

— Soojin

Thanks, Soojin — this is very helpful and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from our side:

- Steady-state: we expect the 400 RPS to be an average across ten regional shards (so per-shard baseline could be lower); happy to have Redwood run the harness from our primary region (us-west-2).
- Token lengths: the 120/220 averages are right, but tail lengths can spike (we have about 2% of requests > 1,200 tokens). Will that affect the cost/latency targets?
- Quality checks: we can provide a blind test set of ~1,000 prompts for automated comparisons.

Procurement — Priya is our procurement lead and will own contract redlines (Priya, looping you in). For security, we’ll need an SOC2 attestation and an IP/data flow diagram before kickoff.

Prebuilt harness: yes, please provide it. We prefer to run it from our infra first and then give you a replay token so you can validate on Redwood’s side.

We’re good to target the EOD 8/24 confirmation. I attached a small traffic sample (realistic shape) — let me know if the tail requires different handling.

Alex
Alex Torres
VP Product — Halcyon AI

Subject: Re: POC Traffic acceptance rubric & kickoff handover — config + proposed kickoff

Alex / Priya — looping in the engineering side. Quick technical readout and plan: 

1) Tail handling: we ran a short projection against a model-variant with comparable architecture. Expectation: 2% tail at ~1,200 tokens will increase 95p latency ~1.1–1.4x under steady-state load. Under a 4k RPS burst the tail could push 95p to ~1.6–1.9x if not throttled. Recommendation: treat tail evaluation separately — gated pass if steady-state targets met and tail shows graceful degradation under defined spike windows.

2) Load harness & replay: we’ll provide the harness by EOD 2027-08-26 and a small runner that you can launch in us-west-2. We’ll include a config file that marks heavy-tail samples so they can be isolated during evaluation.

3) Proposed kickoff: 2027-08-30 09:00 PT (two-week window through 2027-09-13). If procurement needs more time we can shift start by a week.

Attachments: poc-success-rubric-v1.xlsx (finalized tech section), traffic-sample-202708.csv (sample with heavy-tail markers).
